end.parentNote: Riya practised examples of diversity and used specific details such as Pongal rice, Lohri fires, phiran, mundu and settu saree. They initially mixed up unity with doing exactly the same things, but later recognised shared festival ideas, retold stories in different languages and a common musical idea. At home, ask Riya to explain one shared value shown through two different festivals or stories.
